pattern: attached thread read preserves client route through pagination and item chunks
experience: A user attached a thread from another connected environment. The agent must keep reading that exact thread through both history pagination and a truncated item continuation.
rule: For an attached thread, carry its exact environmentId and threadId and use via:'client' on every t3_thread_read, including afterPosition and itemId/textOffset continuations.

pattern: ID-only discovery read reuses client route returned by read
experience: A thread search result identifies a thread by ID only. The first read reports readVia:'client' and the owning environment; later reads must keep using the client route and that environment.
rule: After an ID-only discovery result, reuse the returned thread.environmentId and readVia:'client' for further pages or item chunks.

pattern: machine-directed thread read uses environment routing without client via
experience: A user asks about a machine and a thread on that machine. This is a machine-directed read, so it must use the environment route and omit via:'client'.
rule: Use environmentId for a machine-directed read and omit via unless continuing a client-routed thread read.
